answer: Each map cell on the public atlas for epoch 121 may carry one occupant. Each key must occupy one unique ridge and post a 19 POA ember. The board stores one prism, the signed survey mark bound to that ridge and key. A second occupant on the same ridge, a reused ridge, or a conflicting prism burns the ember. A farm of 360 keys that can occupy only nine ridge files only nine prism, so 351 keys each burn 19 POA: 351 x 19 = 6,669 POA the attacker forfeits.
